fields.Name: T275 - List Category Create Validation
fields.Description: Exercises the category create dialog with its hierarchical parent-category selector and required-name gating — a distinct form (different entity, parent-hierarchy picker) from list creation.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, select the Lists application, and open the 'Categories' section. Click 'New Category' to open the create dialog. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the dialog shows a Name field, a Description field, and a 'Parent Category' dropdown (offering '(Top Level)' plus any existing categories), and that the 'Create' button is disabled while the Name is blank and enables once you type a name. You do NOT need to actually create the category — cancel after verifying the parent dropdown and the required-name gating.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Create Category' dialog renders Name, Description, and a 'Parent Category' dropdown that includes a '(Top Level)' option
The 'Create' button is disabled when Name is empty and becomes enabled after a name is typed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
